steps.what: Retrieve the current engineering brief, specifications and drawing revisions
Interpret the engineering requirements and choose the drawing representation
Create engineering drawings or schematic diagrams using the chosen representation
Check and annotate dimensions, formulas, references and revision details
Explain the drawing and its engineering implications to staff

tasks.design: Configure current-revision search in {DOCS} and reusable blocks, sheet layouts and linked title fields in the {OTHER} engineering drawing application. The technician interprets the requirements, creates and checks the drawing and explains its implications to colleagues; no automatic technical decision or issue is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standard drawing components and revision details are rebuilt around each engineering interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing libraries and linked sheet fields can remove repeated construction and metadata entry.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous requirements, incompatible component conventions and engineering meaning.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a representation that communicates the actual engineering intent.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drafting and metadata entry, with unchanged engineering responsibility.

reach.task: Check whether dimensions and references communicate design intent

evidence.claim: Eplan Electric P8 generates engineering reports and lists, demonstrating native engineering artefact support; the digest does not measure this industrial drawing workflow.
Drawing-block reuse, linked title fields and the task-specific time estimates are model knowledge designs.

assumptions: Boundary includes interpreting inputs, the real drawing write, checking and explanation. Formal engineering release and physical process changes are separate downstream work with no saving claimed; no self-approval stage is added to the author's ordinary save.

The {OTHER} category is the engineering drawing application. Engineering staff supply specification version, required dimensions, units, constraints and design references in the existing brief; s1 counts revision and source verification. The technician produces representation decisions in s2 and captures geometry and component parameters in s3, whose retained 24.5 hours include all nonstandard drafting.

The technician confirms drawing ID, revision, source references, scale and units in s4, retaining 8 hours of annotation and engineering checks. Missing parameters or incompatible library conventions require manual drafting, not inferred geometry.
Test native component libraries and linked title blocks first. s3 saves repeated standard construction only; s4 saves duplicate metadata entry, never the ordinary save or engineering verification.
unknowns: Reusable component coverage and unit compatibility
research_questions: Do reusable components reduce drafting effort after resolving layer, unit and dimension conventions?

already_counted.description: Verify revisions, perform remaining drafting and check annotations

incremental.description: Maintain reusable blocks and validate changed metadata links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=84.5, gross=15.5, upkeep=1, net=14.5. Cautious case: legacy drawings require all 20 input hours and all 10 annotation hours, while incompatible blocks retain 32 of 35 drafting hours; other 35 hours remain, giving 3 gross minus 1 upkeep =2. High 9 requires compatible components but more custom drafting than central.

steps.what: Collect product quality and reliability observations with their provenance
Align sample definitions, units and product versions in the analysis worksheet
Compile statistical measures and charts from the validated analysis table
Evaluate what the statistics establish about product quality and reliability
Write the quality evaluation and maintain its analysis record

tasks.design: Configure an existing source-data view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and a validated statistical workbook in {SPREADSHEET}. The technician verifies comparability and interprets the results, then records the actual evaluation in {DOCS} using linked chart references; no automatic quality disposition or alert is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source records, workbook preparation, repeated calculations and chart copying surround statistical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports, protected formulas and linked chart references can remove those mechanical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Biased samples, changing product versions and reliability observations with unequal exposure.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising that a mathematically correct statistic may not support a quality conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less worksheet assembly and more attention to comparability and evidence limits.

reach.task: Check whether a sample supports a reliability conclusion

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces reports; this supports available source and reporting tooling, not the validity of a chosen statistical method.
Protected statistical formulas, linked charts and all savings estimates are model knowledge designs.

assumptions: Boundary includes compilation, substantive evaluation and the maintained analysis record. Inspection and laboratory measurements are existing other-role work, not free new inputs or credited savings. Corrective-action proposals are separately counted in task 22041.

Inspection staff supply sample ID, product and revision, batch, measurement time, characteristic, value, unit, method, exposure duration where relevant and source reference. s1 counts retrieval and verification; s2 retains 12 hours for unit, sample and version alignment and manual correction. Missing exposure or method information blocks the relevant comparison.

The existing quality method owner supplies a calculation profile with measure definitions, grouping, denominator and formula version. The technician confirms its applicability while producing the validated table in s2; this confirmation time is retained. s3 runs only that checked profile, with manual calculation as fallback when assumptions fail.

Native exports and protected workbook templates come first. s5 retains 6 hours to write the actual interpretation and verify chart references, saving only repeated chart copying and layout. Ordinary author saves have no gate or saving; existing system runtime is not labour.
unknowns: Source export completeness and measurement comparability
Current protected workbook and chart-link support
research_questions: Does the configured workbook reproduce checked analyses without increasing manual correction of units or denominators?

already_counted.description: Verify measurements, align the analysis and write the final evaluation

incremental.description: Validate formula and export changes against checked examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=63, gross=37, upkeep=2, net=35. Cautious case: mixed product versions retain all 25 source hours and 19 of 20 alignment hours, unusual denominators retain 15 of 20 calculation hours and unreliable chart links retain 8 of 10 record hours; all 25 evaluation hours remain. R=92 gives 8 gross minus 2 upkeep =6. High 24 retains additional formula and output correction beyond central.

steps.what: Review the quality evidence and previous corrective actions
Discuss the observed problem and practical constraints with production colleagues
Choose justified corrective or preventive actions and define their limitations
Write the quality improvement recommendation and supporting rationale

loop.purpose: Draft the selected recommendation without inventing its cause or expected effect
loop.input: technician's action decisions and checked supporting evidence
loop.output: draft recommendation with rationale and stated limitations
loop.check: Technician checks causal claims, feasibility, affected process and proposed verification against the actual evidence and discussions
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported cause or benefit claims are written manually or removed
loop.why_not_simpler: A recommendation needs case-specific reasoning rather than only a standard action code

steps.what: Recommend the proposed actions to engineering and production decision makers

tasks.design: Use linked quality evidence and previous-action search in {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. Draft the actual written recommendation from the technician's decisions, then keep discussion with the responsible engineering and production staff separate; no process change is automatically committed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a clear recommendation repeatedly reconstructs background and evidence around the technician's judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links and bounded prose drafting can reduce that preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain root causes, operational trade-offs and whether the proposed action will help.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a feasible intervention and explaining the limits of the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less recommendation prose, with unchanged advisory authority.

reach.task: Define what evidence would show that an action improved quality
reach.learn: Verification design and limits of causal inference

evidence.claim: Source-linked recommendation drafting and the estimated retained work are model knowledge designs; no digest case measures corrective-action recommendation time.

assumptions: Boundary includes evidence review, production discussion, choosing actions, the real recommendation write and presenting it. Statistical compilation in task 3672 is an input and is not counted again; implementation and later verification receive no saving here.

The technician verifies source record ID, process or product version and problem context in s1. Operator observations are obtained in s2 with all discussion time retained. The technician produces recommended change, justification, limitations and proposed verification in s3, and captures and checks them in s4's retained 15 hours; no machine-produced root-cause flag is assumed.

Test native evidence links and recommendation templates first. A model may express supplied decisions but cannot choose or implement actions. Ordinary author saves have no approval stage or saving; showing a document in the internal discussion does not imply an uncounted automated send.
unknowns: Current time spent on real recommendation writing
research_questions: Does a bounded draft reduce writing time without overstating causality or removing implementation caveats?

already_counted.description: Verify source context and correct the written recommendation

incremental.description: Maintain source-link templates and sample unsupported recommendation claims

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=87, gross=13, upkeep=1.5, net=11.5. Cautious case: a novel defect requires all 20 context hours and careful recommendation writing retains 22.5 of 25 hours; all other 55 hours stay, giving 2.5 gross minus 1.5 upkeep =1. High 7 retains extra causal-language correction beyond central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify the applicable quality assurance specifications and record revisions
Read worker logs and processing sheets into a checked review table

loop.purpose: Extract candidate record facts without deciding their compliance
loop.input: identified source records and required specification fields
loop.output: draft review table with source locations and unresolved fields
loop.check: Technician compares extracted values, units, dates, signatures and qualifiers with the original records; an unreadable field remains unresolved
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction; handwriting ambiguity or conflicting references returns to manual reading
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable forms and free-text qualifiers prevent reliable fixed-column parsing across the full record set

steps.what: Compare verified record facts with explicit quality specification requirements
Resolve ambiguous evidence and decide whether records adhere to specifications
Enter the actual quality record review conclusions and evidence references

tasks.design: Use existing review templates first, then a bounded extraction from {DOCS} into {SPREADSHEET} only where fixed parsing fails. Deterministic comparisons apply explicit checked requirements; the technician resolves meaning and records the conclusion in the {OTHER} quality records system, with no automated release or escalation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variable logs require repeated reading, transcription and comparison against explicit requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked extraction can prepare candidate facts, and plain comparisons can handle confirmed numeric or mandatory-field requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Handwriting, conflicting versions and whether a recorded observation is substantively adequate.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing a completed-looking record from evidence that actually satisfies the requirement.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription and rule comparison, with unchanged compliance judgement.

reach.task: Explain why a record does or does not support compliance
reach.learn: Specification provenance and treatment of unresolved evidence

evidence.claim: Variable-record extraction, deterministic requirement comparison and native review-field reuse are model knowledge designs; the digest does not demonstrate this precise log-review workflow.

assumptions: Boundary includes reading the actual records, verifying their adherence and entering the existing quality-review result. Original production logs are other-role work with no credited saving. No trailing report, automatic alert, product release or corrective-action send is added.

Operators and inspectors produce original record ID, product or batch, process revision, observation time, characteristic, value, unit and required sign-offs. s2 retains 15 hours for capture correction and source verification; unreadable values remain unresolved and require manual reading.

The quality method owner supplies authoritative specification ID, version, applicability, required fields, numeric limits, units and comparison operators. The technician produces the checked profile in s1, retaining all 15 hours for selection, manual mapping and checking. An implicit or judgement-based requirement is routed to s4, never turned into a guessed numerical rule.

The {OTHER} category is the quality records system. s5 retains 7 hours to capture the actual conclusion and confirm references; its saving is repeated field entry avoided, not an ordinary author save. Test native review templates and fixed parsers before bounded extraction or custom comparisons.
unknowns: Proportion of specifications expressible as explicit comparisons
research_questions: Can verified extraction and explicit comparisons reduce review time while preserving unresolved and contradictory evidence?

already_counted.description: Select specifications, verify extraction, resolve ambiguity and record conclusions

incremental.description: Maintain specification mappings and sample extraction and comparison errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=57, gross=43, upkeep=3, net=40. Cautious case: handwritten forms retain 27 of 30 extraction hours, judgement-heavy specifications retain 22 of 25 comparison hours and limited field reuse retains 9 of 10 entry hours; all 35 specification-selection and decision hours stay. R=93 gives 7 gross minus 3 upkeep =4. High 25 retains more source checking and manual requirements than central.
